messages.subject: Senior International Executive | Mining, ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Varela,

I am reaching out for consideration for senior executive search mandates across Latin America and N2Growth's wider international network.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and senior stakeholder coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest fit is in Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where business strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution across corporate, technical, community and public-sector stakeholders. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate and rotational appointments across the GCC, Africa, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas.

Given your role within N2Growth's Latin America team, I would value consideration for current or future mandates and, where appropriate, referral across the firm's global network to colleagues covering mining, natural resources, energy, sustainability and country leadership.

My executive CV is attached for review. Target areas include Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Social Performance, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership, Energy Transition and Mining and Resources leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
